name: FORMALINUM
common_names: Aqueous Solution (35 per cent) of Formaldehyde Gas
key_symptoms: Food feels as if it were a ball in stomach. Burning in mouth and stomach.
guiding_symptoms: Food feels as if it were a ball in stomach. Burning in mouth and stomach.
gi_symptoms: Food feels as if it were a ball in stomach. Burning in mouth and stomach.
skin_symptoms: Puckers skin like leather; wrinkles; scales off. Eczema in neighborhood of wound. Damp sweat most marked on right upper extremity.
fever_symptoms: Chills in forenoon, followed by long fever. Bones ache during whole paroxysm. During fever forgets where he was.

source.title: FORMALINUM - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
